standard-dialogue.npc: Oh, hello. Have you got something you want preserving?

steps.npc: Give it to me to look at then.
Well, you go kill things so I can stuff them, eh?
If you bring me a monster head or a very big fish, I can preserve it for you so you can mount it in your house.
I hear there are all sorts of exotic creatures in the Slayer Tower -- I'd like a chance to stuff one of them!

using-items-on-her-anything-other-than-t.npc: Don't be silly, I can't preserve that!

using-items-on-her-raw-chicken.npc: Killing a chicken is hardly worth boasting about!

using-items-on-her-raw-fish.npc: That's a pretty ordinary fish, isn't it? Not really worth preserving.

using-items-on-her-raw-fish.player: You should have seen the one that got away!

using-items-on-her-big-bass.npc: That's a mighty fine sea bass you've caught there.
I can preserve that for you for 1,000 coins.

using-items-on-her-big-bass.text: If the player does not have enough coins:
If the player has enough coins:

steps.npc: All right, come back if you change your mind, eh?

using-items-on-her-big-swordfish.npc: Don't point that thing at me!
I can preserve that for you for 2,500 coins.

using-items-on-her-big-harpoonfish.npc: Goodness me! That thing's more of a weapon than a fish!
I can preserve that for you for 3,500 coins.

using-items-on-her-big-shark.npc: That's quite a fearsome shark! You've done everyone a service by removing it from the sea!
I can preserve that for you for 5,000 coins.

using-items-on-her-giant-blue-krill.npc: I can preserve that for you for 5,000 coins.

using-items-on-her-golden-haddock.npc: I can preserve that for you for 5,000 coins.

using-items-on-her-orangefin.npc: I can preserve that for you for 5,000 coins.

using-items-on-her-huge-halibut.npc: I can preserve that for you for 5,500 coins.

using-items-on-her-purplefin.npc: I can preserve that for you for 6,000 coins.

using-items-on-her-swift-marlin.npc: I can preserve that for you for 6,500 coins.

using-items-on-her-crawling-hand.npc: That's a very fine crawling hand.
I can preserve that for you for 1,000 coins.

using-items-on-her-cockatrice-head.npc: A cockatrice! Beautiful, isn't it? Look at the plumage!
I can preserve that for you for 2,000 coins.

using-items-on-her-basilisk-head.npc: My, he's a scary-looking fellow, isn't he? He'll look good on your wall!
I can preserve that for you for 4,000 coins.

using-items-on-her-kurask-head.npc: A kurask? Splendid! Look at those horns!
I can preserve that for you for 6,000 coins.

using-items-on-her-abyssal-head.npc: See how it's still glowing? I'll have to use some magic to preserve that.
I can preserve that for you for 12,000 coins.

using-items-on-her-kbd-heads.npc: Three?! This must be a King Black Dragon!
I'll have to get out my heavy duty tools -- this skin's as tough as iron!
I can preserve that for you for 50,000 coins.

using-items-on-her-kq-head.npc: That must be the biggest kalphite I've ever seen!
Preserving insects is always tricky. I'll have to be careful...
I can preserve that for you for 50,000 coins.

using-items-on-her-kq-head-tattered.npc: That's not the most impressive head I've seen but I think I can just about manage this one.
Preserving insects is always tricky. I'll have to be careful...
I can preserve that for you for 50,000 coins.

using-items-on-her-vorkath-s-head.npc: This blue dragon smells like it's been dead for a remarkably long time. Even by my standards, it smells awful.
I can preserve that for you for 50,000 coins.

using-items-on-her-alchemical-hydra-head.npc: This hydra looks like it might fall to pieces soon. I'll have to be careful to preserve it properly.
I can preserve that for you for 50,000 coins.
